verdict.rationale: Undermind is explicitly a scholarly/literature research engine that reads full-text PDFs, follows citations and key authors, and traces statements back to source papers, and community feedback confirms it surfaces relevant academic papers beyond simple web search (comparisons to Google Scholar, Arxiv, Science Direct). Some users note gaps like missing gray literature/dissertations, indicating imperfect but genuine coverage of scholarly sources. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking against dedicated scholarly databases (PubMed, Web of Science) and no clear evidence of primary-source archival material beyond papers.
